The Edron orcs have learned to breed {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and are becoming a serious threat. {npc:Daniel Steelsoul} sends you to the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave} to destroy the 4 {item:Spider Egg|spider eggs}, on a mission he clearly thinks is suicidal. If you come back alive, you receive a {item:Terra Amulet}.
The orcs of Edron have started breeding giant spiders and are becoming a serious threat. The city needs a hero to stop them.
A melee weapon (or a {item:Firebug}) to destroy the spider webs
recommended against the Orc Shamans and their summons
Bring antidotes or the {spell:Cure Poison} spell: the spiders poison you.
Each destroyed egg spawns a {creature:Giant Spider} behind you. Make sure you can kill it before you break the next egg.

Make the most of the trip: the same cave has the {wiki:Dark Armor Quest|Dark Armor Quest}, the {wiki:Barbarian Axe Quest|Barbarian Axe Quest}, the {wiki:Berserker Treasure Quest|Berserker Treasure Quest}, the {wiki:Poison Daggers Quest|Poison Daggers Quest} and the {wiki:Shaman Treasure Quest|Shaman Treasure Quest}.

In **Edron**, talk to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. The mission: destroy the spider eggs that the Giant Spider captured by the orcs is hatching.

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
2. Get to the Edron Orc Cave
Go to the {wiki:Edron Flats|Edron Flats}, just **south** of Edron castle, and look for a {item:Sewer Grate}. Go in and follow the sewer until you come out on the surface on the other side.
The Sewer Grate in the Edron Flats
On the surface, go **south** to the Edron Orc Cave entrance. It is hidden under a mountain: if you can't see it, use the minimap.
The entrance of the Edron Orc Cave, hidden under the mountain
Here you find {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and some {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.
On the first floor, if a stone blocks your way, pull the lever to remove it. Fight your way to the far **south** of the floor and go down the hole.
The lever that removes the stone from the way
The same monsters, but with more {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.
Floor 2: do not go down the first hole
Go **west** until you find a hole. **Do not go down it**: instead go **north** and then **east**, to the first room. Go down the hole in **that** room.
The right hole, in the first room to the north and east
1–2 {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} lured from other areas may appear.
Floor 3: clear the Orc Shamans room
As soon as you land, you are surrounded by several {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and their summons. Clear the room.
Area runes like {item:Great Fireball} are ideal here.
Go **west**, turn **north** as soon as you can and follow the path north over the {wiki:Black Marble Floor|black marble floor}. Go down the hole.

You will find many {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and even {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}. Go **north** to a large pit with a {creature:Giant Spider}. Go down the ramp on the **northeast** side of the pit and kill the Giant Spider.
Map of the Giant Spider pit floor
Use a melee weapon (or a {item:Firebug}) on the {item:Spider Webs|spider webs} on the wall to open a way to the eggs.
The spider webs on the wall

**Use** each {item:Spider Egg} to destroy it. Every time you destroy one, a {creature:Giant Spider} spawns some distance behind you: kill it and move on to the next egg. Destroy all **4 eggs** to complete the mission.
If you are not alone, you will have to wait for the eggs to respawn: there are only eggs for one player at a time.

Go back the same way: go up the pit's ramp and, on each floor, return to the spot where you fell and use the {item:Rope} to go up (following the same maps in reverse). On the first floor go back **north** to the entrance and leave to the surface ({coord:33173,31900,7}). Then go **north** to where you came out of the sewer and retrace the path to the **Edron Flats** (dig the passage with the {item:Shovel} if it is covered).
After leaving the cave (or after doing the other quests in the same cave first), go back to {npc:Daniel Steelsoul}. Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}.
The quest is part of the Tibia Tales.
